description: The chart illustrates the performance comparison between smaller and larger Large Language Models (LLMs) on two datasets, MATH-500 and AIME24, using different methods, CoT and TTS. The chart is divided into six sub-charts, labeled (a) to (f), each representing a specific model and dataset combination. The horizontal axis contains categories representing different models, while the vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0 to 100 for MATH-500 and 0 to 90 for AIME24, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5 or 10. In each sub-chart, the bars are colored according to the legend, indicating the model used, and are patterned to distinguish between CoT and TTS methods. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and their heights correspond to the performance scores, with values ranging from approximately 9.3 to 97.3. The models are not sorted in a specific order across sub-charts, but within each sub-chart, the bars are presented in a specific order corresponding to the model labels. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern. The performance scores are annotated with exact values on top of or within the bars.
